keyFindings.description: A parked write refused at resume delivers the refusal only as the error of the read that returns its body's last bytes; an unkeyed multipart upload's parser finds its closing boundary in the buffered data and never reads that error, so the handler stores and commits the file holding no unit, and begin then replaces its 201 with 429 OVERLOADED 'nothing ran': a client that follows Retry-After uploads twice.

boundedAnswer.Write arms the idle deadline once per call; WriteJSON and a row-held file version write the whole answer in one call, so a 25 MiB download is cut at 20 s below about 1.3 MB/s and a 1 MB JSON answer below 50 KB/s, a regression from main and contrary to the PR's 'an honest slow reader completes'.

expire also sets computing with readingKnown false, so a change caught up during an expiry is held in startingSeq, changeSeq moves past it, and expire never resolves it: the view keeps a stale answer until something else touches it (6c4847f0).
